title: Friendly banter
subtitle: Two friends trade jokes, then one sets a boundary
tests: False-positive handling: insult words between friends should not alert; a boundary is set and respected

messages.text: MEERA. you absolute clown 😂 you left your bag on the bus AGAIN
omg shut up 😭 at least i didn't fall asleep in maths
that was ONE time loser lol
loser says what 😂 you're so dumb i love you
ugh you're the worst. practice at 5? bring the snacks or you're dead to me 💀
be honest how bad did i look at practice
like a confused penguin 🐧 but a cute one
rude!!! ok fair 😂 night night clown 🤡
ok the clown thing was funny but i'm kinda done with it now. can you drop it?
oh ok, fair! no more clown, promise 🤝

expect.notes: RoBERTa is expected to flag some messages; context should override them.

intro: Meera and her friend Riya tease each other constantly. On Day 2 Meera asks Riya to drop a nickname.

checkpoints.label: Day 2 · Meera has just set a boundary
checkpoints.intro: Meera asked Riya to stop calling her "clown". Continue as Riya: respect it, or ignore it.
suggestions: oh ok, fair! sorry 🙏 see you tomorrow
lol no, clown forever 🤡 i told the whole class to call you that

checkpoints.label: Day 2 · end of the script
checkpoints.intro: The boundary was respected. Continue with anything, harmless or not.
suggestions: actually the whole class thinks you are a clown
